The cat has its eyes closed, displaying a classic brown and black mackerel tabby pattern with distinct stripes on the forehead and cheeks. The ears are pointed and erect, covered in fine fur. The nose is pinkish-brown, and long white whiskers extend from the muzzle. The background consists of white horizontal blinds, and a small portion of a red surface is visible at the bottom right.
